title: Grateful Dead Live at Utica Memorial Auditorium on 1973-03-22

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard recording of the Mar 22 1973 Utica show with a smoking China Cat Sunflower→I Know You Rider and soaring Here Comes Sunshine.
ai_review.review: The Utica 3/22/73 set shines on both fronts – the soundboard source is crisp, loud and well‑balanced, while the band delivers an electric performance highlighted by a blistering China > Rider, a majestic Here Comes Sunshine and a cosmic Other One.  Jerry’s guitar work, Phil’s “bombs” and Bill’s propulsive drumming keep the energy high from the mellow first set into a jam‑filled second half.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, average ~4.5 stars, consistent praise for both musical performance and audio fidelity; only a single low‑rating comment about missing tracks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, loud and well‑balanced mix; reviewers note crisp sound with minimal noise, occasional minor reduction but no drop‑outs. Missing intro/outro tracks noted but do not affect overall fidelity.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions from a mellow, poetic first set into a high‑energy second set; segues such as China > Rider and Truckin'→Other One flow naturally, keeping momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for scorching solos, slide work on Truckin', noodling in the China jam, and overall “shreddin’ the skies.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted for powerful bass “bombs,” driving the jam in Playin' and The Other One, plus his humorous fire‑aisle rap.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s tasteful fills noted during Bird Song and Dark Star‑like moments; keyboards add melodic depth throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s drumming described as fine, tight, with double‑time bursts that lift the band’s intensity.
